Elderly Couple Hit by SUV in Delhi; Driver Arrested

An elderly couple was struck by an SUV in Kirti Nagar, Delhi. The driver of the SUV has been arrested. CCTV footage reportedly shows the couple being flung into the air after the vehicle collided with them outside a temple.
